scientific_integrity: Originality and correctness assessed against the stated literature and accompanying analytic argument; finite reproducibility checks do not establish the infinite-parameter theorem; no independent scientific validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Unique endemic equilibria of finite-type sudden-loss SIRS models only, with identical contact, recovery, birth and death parameters, positive reciprocal waning durations and supercritical basic reproduction number. Convex order is imposed on reciprocal rates, not rates; no global-attraction, vaccination or gradual-waning comparison is asserted.
title: Convex-order endemic prevalence in multi-type SIRS waning models
